items.title: “FMV”に収録された「ARENA」が約30年を経て復活。新モード導入で大幅にボリュームアップした「アリーナリメイク」が2026年冬発売へ
items.summary: ダットジャパンは本日（2026年7月24日），ターン制RPG「アリーナリメイク」をNintendoSwitchとPC（Steam）で2026年冬に発売すると発表した。本作は，1990年代初頭にPC向けゲームソフト集「GAMEPACK」へ収録され，富士通のFMVシリーズにもプリインストールされていた「ARENA」のリメイク版だ。

zh.title: 收录在《FMV》中的《ARENA》时隔约30年再次回归。引入新模式，体量大幅增加的《竞技场重制版》将于2026年冬季发售
zh.summary: Dat Japan 今天（2026 年 7 月 24 日）宣布，回合制角色扮演游戏《Arena Remake》将于 2026 年冬季在 Nintendo Switch 和 PC（Steam）上发售。本作是 1990 年代初收录在 PC 游戏软件合集《GAMEPACK》中、也预装在富士通 FMV 系列中的《ARENA》的重制版。

en.title: “ARENA”, which was included in “FMV”, is back after about 30 years. "Arena Remake", which has been significantly increased in volume with the introduction of a new mode, will be released in winter 2026
en.summary: Dat Japan announced today (July 24, 2026) that the turn-based RPG "Arena Remake" will be released on Nintendo Switch and PC (Steam) in winter 2026. This work is a remake of ``ARENA,'' which was included in the PC game software collection ``GAMEPACK'' in the early 1990s, and was also preinstalled in Fujitsu's FMV series.

Leadership abilities, area adjacency bonuses, technology and municipal Eureka, and the restraint relationship between different arms. If you play a little more seriously, you need to constantly check the strategy and calculations. What's more troublesome is that it can easily give people the illusion of "sleep after playing this round".
